question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is from.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• From is used to indicating the point in time at which a particular process, event, or activity starts.

 -Example: The show will run from 10 a.m. to 2 p.m.

 
• 'From' is the **preposition** used to to show direction, time, place, location, spatial relationships, or to introduce an object.
 
• 'From' is usually used to refer to the place where someone or something starts or originates.
 
• Hence, the most appropriate option to fill in is 'From'.

​Therefore, the correct answer is option 4.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• 'By' is used to refer to arrangements and deadlines.
 
• 'With' means having or possessing (something).
 
• 'Of' means expressing the relationship between a part and a whole.
